Name: Hippo's Farm Cave Variety
Author: acearohippo
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Overview: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
There are several Farm Cave mods out there, but most of them focus on just expanding the size, either to incorporate more craftables or to add a gimmick, like a minecart to another portion of the farm. That's all fine and wonderful, but I need to have my spaces look lived in/lively. I love mods that are more for the aesthetic, so I hunkered down and cranked out eight (8) different farm cave types, to match farm types plus two extras for funsies!
This mod is probably not compatible with any farm maps that edit the farm cave. Sorry, but I will not be making compatibility patches. I do encourage personal edits if you would like to use one of my farm caves. Feel free to message me asking how to do so.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Current Update: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
[b]PC/Mobile 1.0.4[/b]:
Fixed the warp from the Mining Farm Cave (Hilltop) where the warp blocked the farmer from reaching the entrance.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Features: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Each farm cave comes with a designated spa area and a tidied area for big-craftables. Forage spawns at a normal rate. There is a mobile (SDV .1.4) version that only has 5 out of the 8 maps, with 5 of those maps being an automatic choice depending on your farm type. Maps are configurable, with there being an option for Automatic farm caves, which automatically detect your farm type and choose the matching cave type. There is also a choice between two cave types for Combat cave (Wilderness Farm) and Island Cave (Beach Farm).

[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Requirements: - - -[/center][/size][/color]

[*]DaisyNiko Tilesheets
[*]DustBeauty's Hot Spring Farmcave, for the hotspring to work! See [color=#6aa84f]Install/Uninstall[/color] section for more details. Technically optional as long as my version of hotspring farm cave is never used
[/list][/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Install/Unistall: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left] Extract zipped files and place content in your Mods folder. Within the [CP] Farm Cave Variety folder, there is another folder marked "DustBeauty Compatibility". Take the content.json that is located within that file and replace DustBeauty's content.json. What I did was 1) make it so that their tilesheet loads so it didn't need to be included within my mod (which would be stealing) and b) put in a disable/enable config so my maps can show up. I automatically set it to "false" so that there is less tinkering on all y'all's parts, but if you would like to go back to it, simply enable it again.

To uninstall, make sure all objects, big-craftables, and forage is removed from the area, then remove my mod.[/left][/size]
